review_candidates.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
review_candidates.company: مجموعة خليفة القابضة - Khalifa Holding Group
review_candidates.description: About us. We are a leading construction company in Libya, specializing in large-scale infrastructure & Construction projects. With a workforce of over 10,000 employees representing more than 23 nationalities, we take pride in our diverse and highly skilled team. Driven by a commitment to excellence, quality, and innovation, we consistently set industry benchmarks. To further strengthen our leadership structure. Position We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Design Engineer specialized in (Stormwater, Firefighting, Plumbing, and Wet Utilities) and focuses on designing systems that manage water (drainage, flood control) and fire protection for large projects like utilities, hospitals , malls , airports, and buildings projects, Coordinate with other disciplines (architectural, electrical, civil), Ensure compliance with international codes and standards for large projects and designs comply with local regulations and international standards. Responsibilities Reviewing of design calculations for HVAC system including Heat Load, Chiller capacity, Pressure drop calculations for chilled water system, Duct design calculations, External static pressure calculations, Exhaust system calculations, Fresh air calculations, Stair case pressurization calculations, Smoke exhaust system calculations etc. using ASHRAE standards and latest available software. Reviewing of Hydraulic calculations, pump sizing & system pipe sizing for Domestic water system, hot water system, central filtration system ,Firefighting pumps & tank capacity for Fire sprinkler system , firefighting dry and wet hydrant systems and drainage system using latest available software Preparation of Technical Bid Evaluation of equipment and highlight positive and negative aspects of the equipment proposed. Reviewing mechanical and architectural Design Drawings, structural drawings, combined services coordinated drawings & Shop Drawings in relation with MEP scope. Reviewing, Coordinating & finalizing field design changes. Preparing presentations, design reports & functional reports as per the instructions of the Line Manager Reviewing of Material specifications, list of manufacturers, available suppliers and general specifications. Technical clarification with the vendors for their proposed equipment. Design stormwater drainage systems (pipelines, culverts, channels, manholes). Perform hydraulic and hydrological calculations (rainfall, runoff, flood levels). Size pipes and slopes using standards and software. Design fire protection systems (hydrants, sprinklers, hose reels). Calculate water demand and pressure requirements. Prepare detailed drawings using software like AutoCAD, Revit, or Civil 3D. Attend design meetings and site visits. Ensure safety, reliability, and cost-effectiveness. Prepare design reports and calculations. Review shop drawings and material submittals. Develop basis of design reports (BODR) and technical memorandums for small-to- large size projects, setting criteria for following design stages. Review the design and specification of fire safety systems (fire alarm systems, notification systems, automation of Gas/water fire extinguishing /emergency escape systems). Ability to calculate number of nozzles, gas capacity, pipeline selection/layout, air pressure and water pressure etc. Routine Report & Write Technical note; Maintaining complete records and archives as company standards. Requirements Education: Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field. Experience: Minimum 5 years' experience in design and reviewing design, installation, testing and commissioning for MEP systems for similar Projects. Technical Expertise: In-depth knowledge of international standards such as NFPA, ASHRAE, SMACNA, NPC, IBC, ASME,ANSI, MSS including MS office, AutoCAD, Revit etc. Detailed understanding of materials and equipment selection Adaptability: Strong troubleshooting skills and understanding of international codes. Communication: Native in Arabic (written and spoken); English proficiency is a strong advantage.

review_candidates.title: Human Resources Manager
review_candidates.description: HR Manager – Egypt Join Alorica and Make an Impact About Us At Alorica, we only do one thing – make lives better, one interaction at a time. We're a global leader in customer service and experience, serving the world's biggest brands with tens of thousands of employees in hundreds of locations around the globe. We're the largest minority-owned CX provider, delivering digital-first, people-centered experiences for some of the world's most respected brands. For over 25 years, we've been helping businesses solve their toughest customer experience challenges — and we do it better than anyone else. As a Top Place to Work, we're serious about creating an environment where people show up as their genuine selves. Which means when you succeed, we all do. Here's What The Job Really Looks Like Reporting directly to the HR Director, you will manage day-to-day HR operations for Egypt, working in close partnership with the Director on compliance, employee relations, and site support. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. You will support grievance investigations, onboarding and offboarding, disciplinary process, and day-to-day vendor and systems coordination, while directly managing the HR team. Manage the site day-to-day HR operations. Partner closely with the HR Director on policy application, performance management, disciplinary action, and employee relations matters. Keep HR policies and processes consistent with Egyptian regulatory requirements, and in line with our global policies Counsel employees and maintain positive employee relations; act as liaison between employees and management. Monitor team-level employee satisfaction and attrition trends and flag concerns early. Manage and develop the HR team, ensuring cross-trained coverage and consistent day-to-day delivery. How You'll Make An Impact Get fluent in Alorica's Egypt HR operations, compliance posture, and systems. Build strong working relationships with the HR team, Site Leadership, and cross-functional partners in addition to our external vendors. Be running Egypt HR operations day-to-day in close partnership with the HR Director. Contribute to a stronger compliance culture in Egypt, reduce operational risk, and help build a cross-trained team to support continued headcount growth. What'll Set You Up For Success 5+ years of HR experience, including HR operations, employee relations or compliance. Expert in Egyptian Labour Law. Experience in a BPO/CX, contact center, or other high-volume operational environment is a plus. Previous experience in managing a team is preferred. Strong communication and coordination skills; reliable follow-through and comfortable flagging issues early. Fluent in English is a must. WHY ALORICA? Our culture shows up in how we work together, support each other, and show up for our clients. We're bold enough to challenge how things have always been done, committed to delivering results that matter, and passionate about creating customer experiences that work. TIDE is our connection group built around real conversations, shared experiences, and genuine belonging. MLBA (Making Lives Better at Alorica) is our employee-led nonprofit where local teams raise funds and support colleagues and communities when it matters most. We don't just talk about culture, we build it, live it, and keep making lives better every day. OUR VALUES Bold – We challenge conventions and take smart risks. Relentless – We deliver results, no matter what it takes. Connected – We work as One Alorica because we're stronger together. True – We show up as our authentic selves, every single day. READY TO JOIN US? If you're looking for a place where your expertise matters, your voice is heard, and your work drives real impact in Alorica's largest EMEA market, let's talk. Apply today! review_candidates.title: Corporate Travel Consultant
review_candidates.description: Company Description Mezwalah I مزوله is a destination management company specializing in tailored travel solutions with a strong focus on high-quality service. The team designs seamless multi-destination itineraries across Saudi Arabia and international markets, supporting corporate and business travel needs. By combining local expertise with global reach, Mezwalah offers customized travel experiences that align with client objectives and budgets. The company values professionalism, reliability, and client-centric service in every engagement. Role Description The Corporate Travel Consultant is a full-time remote role responsible for planning and managing end-to-end travel arrangements for corporate clients. Day-to-day tasks include consulting with clients to understand travel requirements, proposing itinerary options, and coordinating flights, hotels, ground transportation, and other travel services. The role involves handling reservations, monitoring bookings, and resolving issues or changes promptly to ensure smooth travel experiences. The consultant will maintain strong customer service standards, provide cost-effective travel solutions, and stay informed about travel policies, visa requirements, and destination-specific regulations. Collaboration with internal teams and suppliers to optimize travel programs and support corporate travel policies is also expected. Qualifications Candidates should possess skills in Travel Consulting and Travel Management to advise clients and oversee corporate travel programs effectively. Candidates should possess skills in Travel Arrangements and Reservations to coordinate bookings for flights, accommodations, and ground transportation. Candidates should possess strong Customer Service skills to handle inquiries, resolve issues, and deliver a positive client experience. Relevant experience with corporate or business travel, destination management, or travel agencies is highly beneficial. Proficiency in travel booking systems and online reservation platforms, along with strong organizational and time-management skills. Clear written and verbal communication skills in English; additional language abilities are an advantage. Ability to work independently in a remote setting, manage multiple client accounts, and adapt to changing travel requirements. A diploma or degree in Tourism, Hospitality, Business, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory with suitable experience.
